cause: Filtered durable backend returned the protocol-correct four-byte A2 AGAIN on pre-acquisition BUSY. The shared overlay required the success DATA/ACK shape and raised BAD_HANDLER, causing native fail(23).
fix: Permit exact four-byte zero-word AGAIN, destination00/source matching virtual address, only for filtered READ/WRITE/final SYNC; retain all success-shape, request, endpoint and atomic-publication validation.
coverage_gap: Earlier original-SDK enumeration replays made no storage request. Isolated durable BUSY tests therefore did not detect the overlay rejecting the resulting retry.

native_regression.pre_fix: New full native bridge fixture fails with completion refusal23/overlay-8 at first BUSY READ.
cases: three consecutive READ BUSY responses then real successful read
four WRITE phases then final SYNC BUSY without ACK or commit
different WRITE cannot replace pending immutable data and returns AGAIN
original SYNC retry commits once, duplicate SYNC acknowledges without more I/O
physical A1 parent bit and unrelated physical RX unchanged
retry publishes only its four-byte header; remaining virtual RX unchanged
native_regression.scope: Production native worker, overlay, protocol, durable store, CRC and PIO code execute on host with only the external SCI lease boundary and MMIO bus modeled; not console IRQ timing.
